name: Text to Audio
description: Converts text files to speech through the shared AI Provider plugin and writes the files into a folder you choose. Optionally imports the generated audio into the Cove library.
author: binarygeek119

versions.changelog: Rename plugin id to com.binarygeek119.text-to-audio to match the other plugins. Uninstall com.yourcove.text-to-audio if it is still installed.
